cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you go, could you check this window latch?

mechanism: A keeps a departing visitor present by converting each completed window check into a more exact professional test.
confusable: Ordinary safety checking ends when the issue is explained; A repeatedly finds a new small check exactly when B is leaving.
comparison: Cup alternative shifts from household inspection to taxi verification; window alternative extends one controlled test.
seedUse: Latch, moving curtain and fan derive from D26-a; S03 turns A requests into precise isolation of variables rather than ignorance of a switch.
